mechanism: Joint calendar-day expected log growth with bounded component capital weights and optional online exponentiated-gradient learning
source_scope: Physically copied original V7 BIRTH/CLOSE only, native server-day labels. No prior candidate code/model/selected weights or external economic data. Every accepted source trade remains observable; rejected opportunities have no counterfactual label.

periods.development: 2025 complete original lifecycles, jointly compare both fixed roles
periods.confirmation: At most one unchanged development survivor; January-June2026, no alternate or retuning
periods.native_long: 2025-01-01 through2026-07-01 exclusive, adjacent same-contract exact V7 and finalist, $100,1:100,US30/US100/US500 complete real ticks
periods.recent: Only after supportive long, fixed July-August2026 unchanged adjacent pair; exclude from parameter selection
periods.known_exposure: Original aggregate V7/V8 results and different2025 entry/exit selection outcomes are known. This is adaptive development with an unopened candidate-specific2026 confirmation, not a globally pristine holdout.

fit.daily_vector: For each native calendar day, sum unclipped realized stressed_net/planned_entry_risk per component at completed CLOSE. Include every calendar day, including zero-close days. Day vector is joint, preserving simultaneous losses. Each label belongs to the close day and is unavailable beforehand.
fit.objective: Maximize mean(log(1 +0.04*(dot(five_weights,five_day_R)+passive_day_R))) -0.0001*sum((weights-1)^2). This standardized daily return utility is selection, not a replay of actual equity or native compounding.
fit.solver: One deterministic scipy SLSQP from uniform, analytic objective gradient, ftol1e-12,maxiter1000. No grids, restarts or outcome-based regularization change. Reject nonpositive log arguments rather than clip losses.

onnx.graph: Float32 input5 online log displacements; Add learned frozen log weights, Clip[-4,4], Exp to positive allocation scores. Model initializer is learned solely from2024 joint log utility.
onnx.normalization: Deterministic capped proportional projection: find common positive scale with sum(clip(scale*scores,0.25,2.0))=5. Passive weight1. This same bounded normalization is used by Python and EA.
onnx.no_inference_fault_fallback: Invalid graph/state/normalization blocks new candidate entries and records an engineering fault; original protective close duties remain active.

online.update_frequency: At each new server day, apply only complete previous-day realized labels. A close at00:00 belongs to the new day and cannot update that day's opening allocation. Allocation is frozen throughout the day.
online.update: log_displacement_i=clip(log_displacement_i+gradient_i,-2,2); then next day's weights come from frozen ONNX and capped normalization
online.native_observation: Own completed actual native trades only, with realized stressed return normalized by their own reserved planned risk. No unknown blocked-trade outcomes. Preserve day accumulator, previous allocation, displacements, model ID and entry attribution in own durable state.
online.offline_limit: Teacher-population source labels drive the offline update. Different native selection/rounding/admission/own outcomes require new native evidence.

candidate_native_sizing.market_volume: Original day-volume staircase times the selected component weight, rounded to legal step. Never silently round an inadmissible minimum volume into excess risk.
candidate_native_sizing.market_position_cap: Original4% of ConservativeRiskCapital times component weight, explicitly0.01..0.08 at declared bounds; all original stop buffers/headroom stay unchanged. This deliberate candidate risk reallocation is isolated and does not change Live.
candidate_native_sizing.passive: Original fixed0.01 volume, risk, limit geometry and exits; weight1
candidate_native_sizing.signals_management: All original opportunity times/directions, safety, protection, RC4 management and exits retained. No new entry. Lot and risk scaling approximately preserve per-unit stop geometry before rounding, but only native paths can establish it.

proxy.method: Freeze allocation at each original entry's server day. Scale that original lifecycle's actual/stressed net by its entry weight, preserve original population and occupancy, and give zero credit for unknown rejected/new opportunities. This is a fixed-source basket selection, not actual candidate profit or equity proof.
proxy.eligibility: Both actual and stressed source-basket sums strictly improve; both calendar halves actual/stressed positive; stressed improvement>=5%; closed-balance DD<=1.10*control; every original trade represented. No alternative weight/learning-rate/period tuning.
proxy.select: At most one eligible role, highest stressed net, exact tie prefers online. If neither passes, freeze and close all roles without an adjacent cap, gradient, penalty, subgroup or retained-seed rescue.
proxy.confirmation: One unchanged survivor only, same positive-half/profit/5%-stress/closed-DD standards on January-June2026 with causal online state carried from2025. No alternate finalist if it fails.

native_decision: Complete immediately adjacent control/finalist on identical platform, inputs and contract/swaps; actual/stressed terminal wealth and annualized log growth improve, every declared epoch positive, robust recovery improves, native equity DD nominal<=control with only explicitly justified effective min(control+1.5pp,control*1.10). Disclose monthly/lot/turnover/breadth and exact tolerance. Hockey-stick shape is not guaranteed.
engineering: Normal compilation and ordinary economic production/native runs only. No test-only CLI, validators, parity/promotion checkers, tests or CI. Engineering failures remain corrections without arbitrary retry cap.
